impact_local_s02_detail.reason: Superstage S4 permits PLAN_REFINER refinement when acceptance, scope, chosen approach, dependencies, and shared-contract semantics remain unchanged.

impact_absorbed_at_s03.reason: Superstage S4 revises only consumers whose commitments or evidence change and stops propagation at the preserved C-S03@2 contract.

impact_foundational_change.reason: Superstage S4 classifies a changed foundational architecture as replanning and preserves completed work while revising every affected unfinished stage.

replan_before_request_commit.reason: Superstage S1 requires an active replan to be one tracked, unambiguous record; the loop log is not a durable active-replan record.

replan_after_request_commit.reason: The tracked pending record and root Active replan pointer form the durable barrier required by Superstage S1, so structural replanning is the next operation.

replan_drafting_interrupted.reason: An active tracked replan remains an S1 execution barrier; its unique unpublished scratch drafts are resumable authoring state.

replan_published_before_loop_update.reason: The tracked generation-8 root, record publication marker, complete atomic change, and review are publication evidence; reconcile rather than publish a duplicate.

late_predecessor_closeout.reason: Superstage S4 preserves completed history and requires explicit successor evidence; a predecessor closeout does not prove integration of the active successor.

replan_stale_baseline.reason: Superstage S3/S4 treat relevant source and active-vault changes as invalidating evidence; the pending replan requires reassessment before publication.

replan_duplicate_decision.reason: Conflicting pending records for one decision ID are ambiguous evidence; Superstage S1 requires one unambiguous active record.

replan_missing_record.reason: Superstage S1 treats a missing active-replan record as malformed and BLOCKED; it remains an execution barrier until reconciled.

replan_divergent_successors.reason: Superstage S1 candidate validation requires a complete unambiguous path map; two divergent scratch successors cannot authorize publication or execution.

replan_partial_pr_reuse.reason: Superstage S4 preserves predecessor evidence and does not close an old PR by supersession; verified reuse must retain remaining work and rerun review/tests.

replan_split_merge_mapping.reason: Superstage S2 permits split/merge replacements only with fresh stage IDs, explicit replacement mapping, and rewired live consumers, all supplied here.

replan_retained_preparation.reason: Superstage S5 permits compatible-baseline revalidation when the focused receipt binds unchanged stage, source, contracts, evidence, and findings to the new generation.

replan_atomicity_violation.reason: Superstage S1/S2 allow candidate state only with a complete path map and require complete post-publication active validation; the partial working-tree successor is not executable.

replan_internal_pr_not_merged.reason: Superstage S1 active validation is on authoritative tracked main; an unmerged docs-branch candidate cannot clear main's pending active-replan barrier.

legacy_single_leaf_repair.reason: Superstage S4 retains legacy C8 single-leaf repair as structural authoring under REPLANNER.
